for each centre, the average monthly attendance rate in percent for 2023 and for 2024 in two columns

```sql
WITH attendance_2023_cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    "Centre" AS centre_name,
    "Month" AS month,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance
  FROM "attendance_2023"
),
attendance_2024_cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    "centre_name",
    "month",
    "enrolment",
    "average_attendance"
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
rates_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    AVG("average_attendance" * 100.0 / NULLIF("enrolment", 0)) AS avg_attendance_rate_2023
  FROM attendance_2023_cleaned
  GROUP BY centre_name
),
rates_2024 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    AVG("average_attendance" * 100.0 / NULLIF("enrolment", 0)) AS avg_attendance_rate_2024
  FROM attendance_2024_cleaned
  GROUP BY centre_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(r23.centre_name, r24.centre_name) AS centre_name,
  r23.avg_attendance_rate_2023,
  r24.avg_attendance_rate_2024
FROM rates_2023 r23
FULL OUTER JOIN rates_2024 r24 ON r23.centre_name = r24.centre_name;
```
